project: MineGuard Advanced V2.2 - BITM satellite view
notes: Owner builds, tests, self-reviews and merges once CI passes and every dependency is DONE on main. Independent tasks continue; dependent tasks wait. No map tiles or screenshots are committed unless V22-T3 allows it. Detector, sealed TEST data and V2/V2.1 behaviour stay unchanged.

V22-T1.title: Phase plan, task tracking, owner-merges rule and V2.2 CI gate
acceptance: v2_2/tasks manifest and status with V22-T1..T8, owners and dependencies
docs/TEAM.md and CLAUDE.md record the owner builds, self-reviews and merges rule
scripts/v22-gate.mjs validates the plan and PR transitions and runs in CI, with tests

V22-T2.title: Guide live dashboard replacing the existing Render portal
acceptance: One simple page at the existing portal URL: V2.2 tasks, owner, status, ready/blocked, dependencies
Live work from GitHub: open PRs per task, last commit time and CI result, refreshed every minute, marked as not merged
Earlier phases (V1, V2, V2.1) reduced to one small history link
Portal tests updated and passing; the deployed page checked after merge

V22-T3.title: Satellite map source, licence terms and approved BITM location and boundary
acceptance: Decision on the satellite source (MATLAB online basemap) with exact on-screen credit text
What may be committed to the public repository (code yes; map tiles and screenshots only if the terms allow) and what may be shown in a demo
BITM campus centre (WGS84) and boundary from a named approved source, with the source recorded
Builds on v2/research/ENH-008-GEOGRAPHIC-DECISION.md and issue #135

V22-T4.title: Clean satellite preview module rebuilt on current main
acceptance: Standalone module from the retired PRs #72, #75 and #100: satellite basemap centred on the T3 BITM location
WGS84 <-> virtual ENU conversion, on-screen credits, dark and light theme
Honest status: provider metadata and actual tile load reported separately; no network shown as unavailable
Tests (incl. the old #100 cases) run on the owner's machine (MATLAB R2026b; Windows covered by V22-T8) with SHA and checkcode recorded; no tiles or screenshots committed unless T3 allows

V22-T5.title: Virtual V2.1 mission route drawn over BITM and synced with the 3-D demo
acceptance: V2.1 boundary, planned route and live drone position drawn on the satellite view at the BITM origin
Everything labelled VIRTUAL; no mine, target or anomaly markers over real property
Route position stays in step with the 3-D mission clock (ENH-011)
Tests run on the owner's machine (MATLAB R2026b; Windows covered by V22-T8)

V22-T6.title: Satellite tab integrated into V2.1 mission control with offline fallback
acceptance: Satellite tab in the V2.1 application, optional and separate from the offline ENU mission map; plus a Cut/fill map tab from V22-T9; plus the V22-T11 field-survey and V22-T12 relief views
No network: falls back to the ENH-009 offline campus schematic with a clear notice
Offline mission, detector, sealed TEST data and V2/V2.1 behaviour unchanged; startup and frame cost measured
Full V2 + V2.1 + V2.2 regression on Windows recorded

V22-T7.title: Mac verification of the satellite view at the final commit
acceptance: Short satellite tests only (no full regression) on Mac MATLAB R2026b at the final SHA
Tile load, credits, theme and offline fallback observed on the Mac; log committed, no tiles committed unless T3 allows

V22-T8.title: Windows acceptance, guide demo script and V2.2 release record
acceptance: Full regression and a satellite acceptance run on Windows at the final SHA
Demo script updated with the ENH-010 Ballari-to-BITM storyboard and the satellite tab
Release record with limitations: virtual route, no detection claim, map terms

V22-T9.title: Reel-style cut/fill elevation map over BITM from a simulated drone LiDAR survey
acceptance: Elevation surface gridded from simulated LIDAR_TERRAIN returns (points_enu_m) of a flown V2.1 mission, placed at the BITM anchor and labelled SIMULATED TERRAIN (not BITM ground)
Field outline drawn on the satellite view (click points, double-click to finish, undo, cancel), validated, with area in m2 and ha
Best-fit design plane by least squares with editable slope % and heading and a Best fit reset
Cut/fill per cell = existing - design shown red/blue over the imagery, with on/off, transparency slider and legend; cut and fill volumes in m3, cut:fill ratio, max cut/fill, cut per hectare
Contours of existing and design surfaces at a selectable interval, each switchable
Elevation profile tool: draw a line, plot existing vs design along it
Tests on the owner's machine (Windows covered by V22-T8): exact plane fit, analytic volumes on known shapes, clipping, invalid outlines, labels, no imagery committed, compute time recorded

V22-T10.title: Honest evaluation and IMAS wording: bounded null result, false alarms per hectare, detection curve, sealed virtual test area
acceptance: 0 of 13 (the count in the V2.1 logs; earlier summaries said 12) reported as a bounded null result with an exact 95 % Clopper-Pearson interval, recomputed in MATLAB
False alarms per hectare from the recorded V2.1 runs, and a detection-vs-false-alarm curve from event scores
One wording helper used by the v2_2 views: 'SIMULATION - suspected anomaly, indirect evidence only'; never 'clear' or 'safe'
Design of a sealed virtual test area (held-out site, realistic clutter, pre-registered metrics) for later runs
Tests on the owner's machine (Windows covered by V22-T8)

V22-T11.title: Draw any field on BITM, simulated drone survey of it, suspected-anomaly map
acceptance: Operator draws a field anywhere in the BITM view; convex check with a clear message; size limit for run time
Synthetic world and V2.1 survey built for that field; altitude set from the image detail the simulated camera needs (research: about 10-12 m), within V2.1 limits
Private synthetic targets placed in the field (V2.1 placement); simulated flight with RGB/thermal/LiDAR and the frozen detector

Map shows hollow SYNTHETIC / SUSPECTED anomaly symbols with confidence, a coverage-quality layer and a SIMULATION watermark; synthetic targets revealed only in an evaluation toggle; coordinates never exported as findings
Honest results panel using V22-T10 (bounded rates, false alarms per hectare)
Tests on the owner's machine (Windows covered by V22-T8)

V22-T12.title: Relief-anomaly layer: craters, trenches and disturbed ground against the local trend, plus simulated flood/landslide change
acceptance: Relief anomaly = surface minus a local trend surface; features flagged by depth and size, sized on published field measurements (HALO Angola foxholes and craters)
Synthetic craters, foxholes and a trench injected into the simulated surface to demonstrate and test the layer
Optional before/after surface comparison showing simulated flood or landslide soil movement ('where mines could have moved')
Labelled 'INDIRECT EVIDENCE - relief anomaly (SIMULATION)'; never a mine detector or hazard score
Tests on the owner's machine (Windows covered by V22-T8)
